name: CG Animated Feature: Location Interior
description: Image preset for a location interior in the CG Animated Feature look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for an interior. List the room's purpose, three props that say who uses it, and the light source from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: interior view of the location from a doorway or corner, key furniture and props in place, light source visible, room for characters to stand, stylized 3D animated feature film still, appealing simplified proportions, large expressive eyes, sculpted hair shapes, soft subsurface skin, tactile cloth and fur, cinematic three-point lighting, warm key and cool fill, soft global illumination, shallow depth of field
negative_prompt: photorealistic human, uncanny, flat 2d, low-poly, harsh shadows, extra fingers, text, watermark
